column1: Purpose: Take your Core Metrics and work backward from your revenue and profit goal, so you know exactly how many clients, qualified calls, and dollars of acquisition spend it takes to get there.
1. Enter your five Core Metrics in the Actual column: Net Margin, Monthly Churn Rate, Median Monthly Retainer, Close Rate, and Cost Per Call.
2. Enter your Net Profit Goal and the Goal version of each Core Metric in the Goal column, this is what you're working toward.
3. Everything below fills in on its own, working backward from your goal to the exact number of clients, calls, and ad spend required to hit it.
4. The % Difference column shows how far your Actual numbers are from your Goal numbers, use it to see where the biggest gaps are.
5. If your numbers have changed a lot over time, backfill the last 6-12 months so you can see the trend, not just where you stand today.
